thread:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Nordwell's active seats dropped ~45% this week after their product org reorg. Procurement pinged us mentioning a competitor evaluation (Reroute.ai). Can we triage renewal risk?
Samir Patel: Yikes. Do we have usage by workspace or feature? quick peek shows heavy drop in 'summaries' and 'batch-ingest' calls.
Ravi K.: I pulled logs, looks like overall tokens/week down from 420k -> 230k. snippet: ```week_before: 420k tokens
this_week: 230k tokens
most_dropped: summaries pipeline (–62%)```
Katarina Li: Thanks Ravi. @Samir can you confirm whether seats are frozen in billing? Also we should flag CS playbook step: competitive-bakeoff.
Samir Patel: Billing shows 0 seat churn but 3 seat reassignments and 1 PM ramped down. Procurement note mentions feature parity on 'real-time routing' which we don't expose in hosted out-of-the-box.
Maya Chen: Ok actionable: 1) Ask AM to schedule 30m exec sync w/ sponsor and procurement this week 2) Offer targeted enablement on summaries + a temporary volume credit 3) Collect competitor ask list and map to our roadmap.
onboard-bot: Reminder: playbook "renewal-competitive-bakeoff" recommends 30m customer workshop + 2-week free trial extension.
Katarina Li: I'll draft a 1-pager comparing our latency/cost + integration effort vs Reroute.ai. Will call out our Dedicated/private options as an advantage for regulated pipeline.
Samir Patel: I'll own the outreach and propose Wed/Thu slots. Also recommend offering 1-month credit + enablement hours (2x SE).
Ravi K.: From infra POV we can enable a temporary prefix cache boost and priority routing to improve summaries latency for the demo — low risk.
Maya Chen: Great. Samir pls ping once meeting is scheduled. Katarina please attach 1-pager to the thread when ready. I'll prepare renewal playbook checklist and an engagement scorecard (usage baseline + target). :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Noted — scheduling now. Will include @NordwellPM alias and procurement contact.
Katarina Li: 1-pager draft done, uploading to the shared drive: https://drive.company/notes/nordwell-bakeoff 
Maya Chen: Thanks team. If we can show latency + cost delta and run a short enablement, we should reduce churn risk to low. Follow-ups in thread. :eyes:
